name: Kconfig Diff
blurb: two kernel or U-Boot .config files compared, and the difference written as a config fragment
intro: Compares two Kconfig files (kernel, U-Boot, Buildroot or BusyBox .config or defconfig) symbol by symbol, grouped by subsystem, and writes the chosen changes as a fragment for SRC_URI. It reads the files the way scripts/kconfig/confdata.c writes them, tells a symbol that is off from one that is not visible, and a full .config from a defconfig, and flags fragment lines that olddefconfig is likely to drop.

usage: Give a (the old config) and b (the new one) as the text of two .config or defconfig files; kindA/kindB say whether each is a full .config or a defconfig (auto guesses from the header and the number of 'is not set' lines); picks adds (+SYM) or removes (-SYM) symbols from the fragment. It returns counts, a table of every difference with its group, both values, the kind of change (added, removed, y -> m, m -> y, changed, dropped by a dependency, default, toolchain), whether it is in the fragment and a risk note, and texts: the fragment file, the scripts/diffconfig listing and the bbappend lines with the commands to verify. Use it to turn 'what did menuconfig change' into a reviewable .cfg for a Yocto kernel or U-Boot recipe.
sources: Linux scripts/kconfig/confdata.c (the .config line format, # CONFIG_X is not set)
Yocto Project Linux Kernel Development Manual: configuration fragments, kernel_configcheck
poky meta/classes-recipe/uboot-config / u-boot-configure.inc (*.cfg fragments merged for U-Boot)
